title: 上海交大教授：人民币汇率改革，衍生品引入是健康一步
speaker: Yvonne

segments.en: I think like many reforms going on in China or has been going on in China, I think the reform is probably going to be gradual and step-by-step. So in a way, I don't think we're going to see a lot of shocks or impacts to the financial institutions or corporations at the very moment.
segments.zh: 我认为像中国许多正在进行的改革一样，改革可能是渐进的、一步一步的。因此，短期内不会对金融机构或企业造成很大冲击。

segments.en: But I think the introduction of derivatives of China's FX exchange rate trading, I think that is a very healthy step for having more market participants, joining the market, setting the price through different channels.
segments.zh: 但引入人民币外汇交易衍生品是非常健康的一步，可以让更多市场参与者加入，通过不同渠道定价。

segments.en: I think that's always a healthy and constructive direction for the further reform of exchange rate of RMB.
segments.zh: 我认为这对人民币汇率进一步改革始终是健康且建设性的方向。
